literature.headline_zh: 2026年7月汉坦病毒研究进展:儿童心肺综合征、基因组多样性和气候变化影响。
literature.lead_zh: 本周汉坦病毒研究聚焦儿童心肺综合征临床特征、智利安第斯病毒基因组多样性及气候变化对病毒溢出风险的影响。研究显示儿童汉坦病毒心肺综合征可能迅速发展为呼吸衰竭和休克,智利发现两种主要基因组变体,而气候变化可能重组病毒溢出模式。
key_findings_zh: 儿童汉坦病毒心肺综合征可能迅速发展为呼吸衰竭和休克,严重病例需要机械通气、血管活性支持和体外膜氧合。[paper-e7f60da441e68eed]。
智利首次对人源安第斯病毒进行全国性全基因组表征,发现两种主要基因组变体,分布在中部和南部地区,但未发现与疾病严重程度相关的氨基酸特征。[paper-c9c81052bd6f7f36]。
气候变化可能重组病毒溢出模式,预测2041-2060年全球溢出危害将增加,特别是在北美、欧洲和南美的特定地区。[paper-4d1eef53093534ee]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本周研究表明,汉坦病毒的传播和影响正在因气候变化和人类活动而发生变化。儿童心肺综合征的严重性提醒我们需要加强对易感人群的监测和治疗。智利的基因组研究为理解病毒演化提供了新的见解,而气候变化对病毒溢出风险的影响则凸显了需要加强全球监测和公共卫生准备。
literature.caveats_zh: 本周研究主要基于回顾性分析和模型预测,具体的传播动态和临床结果可能因地区和人群差异而异。儿童心肺综合征的研究样本量有限,基因组多样性研究仅限于智利,气候变化模型依赖于多种假设和数据来源,需要进一步的实地研究和验证。
literature.headline_en: July 2026 Hantavirus Research Advances: Pediatric HPS, Genomic Diversity, and Climate Change Impacts.
literature.lead_en: This week's hantavirus research focuses on clinical features of pediatric hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, nationwide genomic characterization of Andes virus in Chile, and climate change impacts on spillover risks. Studies show pediatric HPS can rapidly progress to respiratory failure and shock, Chile identified two major genomic variants, and climate change may restructure viral spillover patterns.
key_findings_en: Pediatric hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome can rapidly progress to respiratory failure and shock, with severe cases requiring mechanical ventilation, vasoactive support, and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.[paper-e7f60da441e68eed]

Chile's first nationwide genomic characterization of human-derived Andes virus identified two major genomic variants with distinct geographical distributions, but no consistent amino acid signatures associated with disease severity.[paper-c9c81052bd6f7f36]

Climate change may restructure viral spillover patterns, with projections showing increased spillover hazards in North America, Europe, and parts of South America by 2041-2060.[paper-4d1eef53093534ee]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: This week's research highlights evolving hantavirus transmission patterns and impacts driven by climate change and human activities. The severity of pediatric HPS underscores the need for enhanced monitoring and treatment of vulnerable populations. Chile's genomic study provides new insights into viral evolution, while climate change impacts on spillover risks emphasize the need for strengthened global surveillance and public health preparedness.
literature.caveats_en: This week's research primarily relies on retrospective analyses and modeling predictions, with actual transmission dynamics and clinical outcomes potentially varying by region and population. The pediatric HPS study has a limited sample size, the genomic diversity research is limited to Chile, and climate change models depend on multiple assumptions and data sources, requiring further field validation.
literature.brief_en: This week's research on hantaviruses highlights significant findings in pediatric cardiopulmonary syndrome, genomic diversity, and climate change impacts. A systematic scoping review of pediatric hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HPS) revealed that the condition can rapidly progress to respiratory failure and shock, with severe cases requiring mechanical ventilation, vasoactive support, and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. In Chile, a retrospective genomic epidemiology study identified two major genomic variants of Andes virus with distinct geographical distributions, but no consistent amino acid signatures associated with disease severity. Additionally, a modeling study projected that climate change may restructure viral spillover patterns, with increased hazards in North America, Europe, and parts of South America by 2041-2060. These findings underscore the need for enhanced monitoring, treatment, and global surveillance to address evolving hantavirus threats.

literature.en: This week's research on hantaviruses highlights significant findings in pediatric cardiopulmonary syndrome, genomic diversity, and climate change impacts. A systematic scoping review of pediatric hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HPS) revealed that the condition can rapidly progress to respiratory failure and shock, with severe cases requiring mechanical ventilation, vasoactive support, and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. In Chile, a retrospective genomic epidemiology study identified two major genomic variants of Andes virus with distinct geographical distributions, but no consistent amino acid signatures associated with disease severity. news.headline_zh: 汉坦病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期新闻资格由来源、日期、正文身份和相关性终审决定；中文翻译状态不影响有效新闻的保留。中文字段不可用时，本区域使用已核验英文内容填充。
key_findings_zh: 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 确认了 5 例与游轮爆发有关的汉坦病毒病例,另有 3 例疑似病例。世界卫生组织通知了其国民下船的 12 个国家。 [news-d0f32702e67179a4]
一名法国旅行者在从MV Hondius号游轮返回后,检测出安德斯汉坦病毒呈阳性。该病例于2026-05-11由法国卫生部长确认。该事件已确认。 [news-dfa2fc3e3064ebd7]
内布拉斯加州医学中心正在对汉坦病毒游轮上的公民进行监测。该状态被作为公共新闻报道。 [news-79e1f161be09dbb4]
据报道,一艘游轮上爆发了汉坦病毒(安第斯病毒株),有确诊病例和疑似病例。唐纳德·特朗普总统和世界卫生组织。状态:正在调查传播途径;未确认已完全包含。市场反应:疫苗制造商(Moderna、Inovio、Novavax、Emergent BioSolutions)的股价隔夜上涨。 [news-e916e8f1d1e7510d]
MV Hondius 游轮上确诊的汉坦病毒疫情已导致 3 人死亡、6 人确诊感染,还有其他疑似病例。世界卫生组织(WHO)和美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)正在做出回应。该事件被疾病预防控制中心列为 3 级紧急响应,即最低的紧急警报级别。 [news-86b4ab82fd528be5]

A French traveler tested positive for Andes Hantavirus after returning from a cruise on the MV Hondius. The case was confirmed by the French Health Minister on 2026-05-11. The event is confirmed. [news-dfa2fc3e3064ebd7]
citizens on a hantavirus cruise ship are being monitored at Nebraska Medicine. The status is reported as a public news item. [news-79e1f161be09dbb4]

A reported outbreak of hantavirus (Andes strain) aboard a cruise ship, with confirmed and suspected cases. President Donald Trump and the WHO. Status: under investigation for transmission routes; not confirmed as fully contained. [news-e916e8f1d1e7510d]

papers.title: Cruise-linked Andes virus and severe hantavirus lung disease: A narrative review
papers.abstract: The 2026 cruise-linked Andes virus (ANDV) outbreak represents a rare but high-consequence travel-associated zoonotic event, combining likely land-based acquisition before embarkation, limited onboard human-to-human transmission, delayed clinical recognition, and multinational public health coordination. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on the outbreak, ANDV biology, transmission dynamics, clinical presentation, diagnostics, management, and implications for maritime and expedition travel medicine. As of 2 July 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) had reported 13 cases linked to the motor vessel (M/V) Hondius outbreak, including 12 laboratory-confirmed infections, one probable case, and three deaths. Following completion of the 42-day follow-up period for all identified contacts without additional secondary cases, WHO considered transmission interrupted and the outbreak contained. Available evidence supports likely land-based acquisition before embarkation followed by limited onboard human-to-human transmission, without sustained spread. Severe hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome may begin with nonspecific fever, malaise, myalgia, gastrointestinal symptoms, or respiratory complaints, then progress abruptly to pulmonary oedema, shock, and fatal cardiopulmonary collapse. Because no licensed antiviral therapy or vaccine is available, early recognition, cautious fluid management, intensive supportive care, ventilatory support, and timely transfer to intensive care or extracorporeal membrane oxygenation-capable centres remain central. The outbreak highlights critical preparedness gaps in shipboard triage, contact tracing, specimen transport, genomic surveillance, risk communication, and cross-border follow-up. Strengthening One Health-informed pre-travel counseling, post-travel symptom surveillance, and maritime outbreak protocols is essential for future expedition-associated zoonotic threats.

papers.abstract_zh: 2026 年与邮轮相关的安第斯病毒 (ANDV) 爆发代表了一种罕见但后果严重的旅行相关人畜共患病事件,结合了登船前可能发生的陆上感染、船上人际传播有限、临床识别延迟以及多国公共卫生协调等因素。这篇叙述性综述综合了有关疫情、ANDV 生物学、传播动力学、临床表现、诊断、管理以及对海上和探险旅行医学的影响的当前证据。截至 2026 年 7 月 2 日,世界卫生组织 (WHO) 报告了 13 例与机动船 (M/V) Hondius 疫情相关的病例,其中包括 12 例实验室确诊感染、1 例疑似病例和 3 例死亡。在对所有已确定的接触者进行 42 天的随访后,没有出现其他继发病例,世卫组织认为传播已中断,疫情已得到控制。现有证据支持可能在登船前发生陆地传播,随后在船上进行有限的人际传播,但没有持续传播。严重的汉坦病毒心肺综合征可能始于非特异性发烧、不适、肌痛、胃肠道症状或呼吸道不适,然后突然进展为肺水肿、休克和致命的心肺衰竭。由于没有获得许可的抗病毒治疗或疫苗,早期识别、谨慎的液体管理、重症支持护理、通气支持以及及时转移到重症监护或具有体外膜氧合能力的中心仍然是核心。这次疫情凸显了船上分诊、接触者追踪、标本运输、基因组监测、风险沟通和跨境后续行动方面的严重准备差距。加强 One Health 旅行前咨询、旅行后症状监测和海上疫情爆发方案对于未来与探险相关的人畜共患威胁至关重要。

papers.title: Neurological Manifestations of Hantavirus Infection: A Review.
papers.abstract: Importance: Hantaviruses have caused several recent human disease outbreaks. They carry a high mortality rate, and some species can spread from person to person although they are typically spread from rodents to humans. Neurological complications have been documented but are poorly understood. Observations: Broadly, 2 types of syndromes have been associated with hantaviruses. The pulmonary syndrome carries a high mortality rate and can result in pulmonary and cardiac failure. Neurological involvement is typically secondary to hypoxic and ischemic injury or metabolic dysfunction. Another manifestation of the infection that is associated with some species of the virus is termed hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. Some patients may develop a meningoencephalitis or pituitary apoplexy resulting in sudden visual loss and pituitary dysfunction. Rarely, seizures, myelitis, and peripheral neuropathy may occur. Although there are no specific antiviral drugs approved for treatment of hantavirus, there are several that showed efficacy in preclinical trials. Management is supportive care and treatment of symptoms. Conclusions and Relevance: Neurological manifestations of hantavirus infection are uncommon but can be severe. Prospective studies and experimental models are needed to better characterize these manifestations, understand pathophysiology, identify therapeutic targets, and develop guidelines for management.

They carry a high mortality rate, and some species can spread from person to person although they are typically spread from rodents to humans. Neurological complications have been documented but are poorly understood. Observations Broadly, 2 types of syndromes have been associated with hantaviruses. The pulmonary syndrome carries a high mortality rate and can result in pulmonary and cardiac failure. Neurological involvement is typically secondary to hypoxic and ischemic injury or metabolic dysfunction. Another manifestation of the infection that is associated with some species of the virus is termed hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. Some patients may develop a meningoencephalitis or pituitary apoplexy resulting in sudden visual loss and pituitary dysfunction. Rarely, seizures, myelitis, and peripheral neuropathy may occur. Although there are no specific antiviral drugs approved for treatment of hantavirus, there are several that showed efficacy in preclinical trials. Management is supportive care and treatment of symptoms. Conclusions and Relevance Neurological manifestations of hantavirus infection are uncommon but can be severe. Prospective studies and experimental models are needed to better characterize these manifestations, understand pathophysiology, identify therapeutic targets, and develop guidelines for management.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines neurological manifestations of hantavirus infection, focusing on disease syndromes, host transmission routes, and the central question of how hantaviruses cause neurological complications in humans [A1, A2, A3].
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a narrative review summarizing documented neurological complications of hantavirus infection without specifying databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria [A13].
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Hantavirus infections primarily cause pulmonary syndrome with high mortality or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome; neurological involvement is typically secondary to hypoxic, ischemic, or metabolic injury [A4, A5, A6, A7]. Neurological complications may include meningoencephalitis, pituitary apoplexy, seizures, myelitis, and peripheral neuropathy, though these are rare [A8, A9].
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The pathophysiology of neurological manifestations remains poorly understood, and there is a lack of prospective studies or experimental models to characterize these complications [A3, A13]. No specific antiviral therapies are approved, and preclinical efficacy has not translated into clinical practice [A10].
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Research priorities include prospective studies and experimental models to elucidate mechanisms, identify therapeutic targets, and develop management guidelines for neurological hantavirus complications [A13]. Clinical management currently relies on supportive care and symptom treatment [A11].

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates neurological manifestations of hantavirus infection, highlighting two primary disease syndromes: pulmonary syndrome with high mortality and hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. Neurological complications, though uncommon, include meningoencephalitis, pituitary apoplexy, seizures, myelitis, and peripheral neuropathy, typically arising from secondary hypoxic, ischemic, or metabolic injury. The review underscores significant gaps in understanding pathophysiology and the absence of approved antiviral therapies, despite preclinical efficacy. Management remains supportive, emphasizing the need for prospective studies and experimental models to clarify mechanisms, identify therapeutic targets, and establish clinical guidelines.

papers.abstract_zh: 重要性:汉坦病毒已引起多起近期人类疾病暴发。它们具有高死亡率,尽管通常由啮齿动物传播给人类,但某些物种可在人际间传播。神经并发症已有记载,但尚不明确。观察结果:总体而言,与汉坦病毒相关的综合征主要有2种。肺综合征具有高死亡率,可导致肺和心力衰竭。神经受累通常继发于缺氧和缺血性损伤或代谢功能障碍。与该病毒某些物种相关的另一种感染表现称为肾综合征出血热。部分患者可能发生脑膜脑炎或垂体卒中,导致突发视力丧失和垂体功能障碍。罕见情况下,可能出现癫痫、脊髓炎和外周神经病变。尽管没有批准用于治疗汉坦病毒的抗病毒药物,但有几种药物在临床前试验中显示出疗效。管理包括支持性护理和对症治疗。结论和相关性:汉坦病毒感染的神经表现虽不常见,但可能严重。需要前瞻性研究和实验模型来更好地描述这些表现,了解病理生理学,确定治疗靶点,并制定管理指南。

papers.title: Hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in children: a systematic scoping review of presentation, critical care management, and outcomes.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Pediatric hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome/hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HCPS/HPS) is rare but can progress rapidly from a nonspecific febrile prodrome to respiratory failure, shock, and multiorgan dysfunction. Pediatric-specific evidence is limited, and a comprehensive map of the clinical literature is lacking. METHODS: We conducted a systematic scoping review per Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidance (protocol registered at DOI:10.17605/OSF.IO/MZDN4). PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane CENTRAL were searched from inception to May 2026. Eligible reports described children or adolescents (age ≤18 years) with HCPS/HPS and extractable pediatric clinical data. Two reviewers independently screened records, assessed overlap, extracted data, and appraised reporting quality using Joanna Briggs Institute tools. RESULTS: Of 2208 database records, 20 reports were included in the core pediatric synthesis after removal of 976 duplicates and screening. Reports were concentrated in the Americas. Recurrent features included fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, myalgia, thrombocytopenia, hemoconcentration, pulmonary edema, respiratory failure, and shock. Severe cases required mechanical ventilation, vasoactive support, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation, and in some cases renal replacement therapy. Larger pediatric case series and surveillance-level reports reported mortality of approximately 33% to 37%. Evidence was predominantly case-based with variable reporting completeness. CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric HCPS/HPS is rare but potentially rapidly fatal. Early suspicion in endemic regions or after rodent exposure, with prompt supportive critical care and timely consideration of advanced cardiopulmonary support, is central to management.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:儿童汉坦病毒心肺综合征/汉坦病毒肺综合征(HCPS/HPS)很少见,但可以从非特异性发热前驱症状迅速进展为呼吸衰竭、休克和多器官功能障碍。儿科特异性证据有限,并且缺乏全面的临床文献图谱。方法:我们根据系统审查和范围审查元分析的首选报告项目 (PRISMA-ScR) 指南(在 DOI:10.17605/OSF.IO/MZDN4 注册的协议)进行了系统范围审查。PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science 和 Cochrane CENTRAL 的检索时间从最初到 2026 年 5 月。符合条件的报告描述了具有 HCPS/HPS 的儿童或青少年(年龄 ≤ 18 岁)和可提取的儿科临床数据。两名评审员使用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所的工具独立筛选记录、评估重叠、提取数据并评估报告质量。结果:在 2208 条数据库记录中,经过删除 976 份重复项和筛选后,20 份报告被纳入核心儿科综合报告中。报告集中在美洲。复发特征包括发烧、胃肠道症状、肌痛、血小板减少、血液浓缩、肺水肿、呼吸衰竭和休克。严重病例需要机械通气、血管活性支持、体外膜氧合,在某些情况下还需要肾脏替代治疗。更大的儿科病例系列和监测水平报告报告死亡率约为 33% 至 37%。证据主要是基于案例的,报告的完整性各不相同。结论:儿童 HCPS/HPS 很少见,但可能会迅速致命。在流行地区或啮齿类动物暴露后及早怀疑,及时提供支持性重症监护并及时考虑高级心肺支持,是管理的核心。

papers.title: First nationwide full-genome characterisation of human-derived Andes virus in Chile: a retrospective genomic epidemiology study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Andes virus (ANDV) is the only hantavirus known to transmit between humans and causes hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in Chile and Argentina. In Chile, ANDV genomic diversity remains incompletely characterised. This study aimed to characterise the genetic diversity, geographical structure, and molecular signatures of ANDV using human clinical samples collected over a 13-year period (2011-24). METHODS: We conducted a retrospective genomic epidemiology study of ANDV infections in Chile. Clinical samples from patients with confirmed ANDV, collected between March 9, 2011, and June 27, 2024, were analysed and sequenced. Clinical and epidemiological data were obtained from diagnostic laboratories and surveillance programmes. Consensus sequences for the S, M, and L segments were generated, and genetic clustering and divergence were assessed using phylogenetic inference and variant calling. FINDINGS: We analysed clinical samples from 58 infected individuals and identified two major genomic variants of ANDV with distinct geographical distributions, defined by regionally structured patterns of nucleotide and amino acid substitutions across the S, M, and L segments: ANDV Chi-North (central Chile) and ANDV-South (southern Chile). No consistent clustering by clinical severity was observed, and no recurrent non-synonymous substitutions were uniquely associated with severe disease. Substitutions previously associated with person-to-person transmission in outbreaks in Argentina were not consistently observed in Chilean sequences, including in four person-to-person transmission cases. Although some substitutions described in ANDV-like viruses were present in the Chi-North lineage, this lineage remained phylogenetically distinct and geographically restricted to central Chile. INTERPRETATION: To our knowledge, this study provides the first nationwide genomic characterisation of human-derived ANDV in Chile. The identification of geographically structured variants indicates that ANDV diversity in Chile is driven by regional diversification rather than clinical outcome. The absence of consistent amino acid signatures associated with disease severity or person-to-person transmission suggests that these phenotypes are unlikely to be explained by viral genetic variation alone. These findings refine current understanding of ANDV evolution and highlight the need for continued integrated genomic surveillance in endemic regions. FUNDING: Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo de Chile and National Institutes of Health.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Andes virus (ANDV) is the only hantavirus known to transmit between humans and causes hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in Chile and Argentina. In Chile, ANDV genomic diversity remains incompletely characterised. This study aimed to characterise the genetic diversity, geographical structure, and molecular signatures of ANDV using human clinical samples collected over a 13-year period (2011-24). METHODS: We conducted a retrospective genomic epidemiology study of ANDV infections in Chile. Clinical samples from patients with confirmed ANDV, collected between March 9, 2011, and June 27, 2024, were analysed and sequenced. Clinical and epidemiological data were obtained from diagnostic laboratories and surveillance programmes. Consensus sequences for the S, M, and L segments were generated, and genetic clustering and divergence were assessed using phylogenetic inference and variant calling. FINDINGS: We analysed clinical samples from 58 infected individuals and identified two major genomic variants of ANDV with distinct geographical distributions, defined by regionally structured patterns of nucleotide and amino acid substitutions across the S, M, and L segments: ANDV Chi-North (central Chile) and ANDV-South (southern Chile). No consistent clustering by clinical severity was observed, and no recurrent non-synonymous substitutions were uniquely associated with severe disease. Substitutions previously associated with person-to-person transmission in outbreaks in Argentina were not consistently observed in Chilean sequences, including in four person-to-person transmission cases. Although some substitutions described in ANDV-like viruses were present in the Chi-North lineage, this lineage remained phylogenetically distinct and geographically restricted to central Chile. INTERPRETATION: To our knowledge, this study provides the first nationwide genomic characterisation of human-derived ANDV in Chile. The identification of geographically structured variants indicates that ANDV diversity in Chile is driven by regional diversification rather than clinical outcome. The absence of consistent amino acid signatures associated with disease severity or person-to-person transmission suggests that these phenotypes are unlikely to be explained by viral genetic variation alone. These findings refine current understanding of ANDV evolution and highlight the need for continued integrated genomic surveillance in endemic regions. FUNDING: Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo de Chile and National Institutes of Health.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:安第斯病毒(ANDV)是已知的唯一可在人与人之间传播的汉坦病毒,并在智利和阿根廷引起汉坦病毒心肺综合征。在智利,ANDV 基因组多样性仍未完全表征。本研究旨在利用 13 年期间(2011-24)收集的人类临床样本来表征 ANDV 的遗传多样性、地理结构和分子特征。方法:我们对智利 ANDV 感染进行了回顾性基因组流行病学研究。对 2011 年 3 月 9 日至 2024 年 6 月 27 日期间收集的确诊 ANDV 患者的临床样本进行了分析和测序。临床和流行病学数据来自诊断实验室和监测项目。生成了 S、M 和 L 片段的共有序列,并使用系统发育推断和变体调用来评估遗传聚类和分歧。结果:我们分析了 58 名感染者的临床样本,并确定了 ANDV 的两种主要基因组变异,它们具有不同的地理分布,由 S、M 和 L 区段的核苷酸和氨基酸取代的区域结构模式定义:ANDV Chi-North(智利中部)和 ANDV-South(智利南部)。没有观察到按临床严重程度进行一致的聚类,并且没有反复出现的非同义替换与严重疾病唯一相关。此前在阿根廷疫情中与人际传播相关的替代现象在智利序列中并未得到一致观察,包括四例人际传播病例。尽管 ANDV 样病毒中描述的一些替换存在于 Chi-North 谱系中,但该谱系在系统发育上仍然不同,并且在地理上仅限于智利中部。解释:据我们所知,这项研究首次提供了智利全国范围内人源性 ANDV 的基因组特征。地理结构变异的识别表明,智利的 ANDV 多样性是由区域多样化而非临床结果驱动的。缺乏与疾病严重程度或人际传播相关的一致氨基酸特征表明,这些表型不太可能仅用病毒遗传变异来解释。这些发现完善了目前对 ANDV 进化的理解,并强调了在流行地区持续进行综合基因组监测的必要性。资助:Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo de Chile 和国立卫生研究院。

papers.title: Andes Virus - A Clinical Review.
papers.abstract: Andes virus (ANDV) is the sole orthohantavirus with documented human-to-human transmission. We summarize the epidemiology and clinical features of ANDV infection and review best practices in clinical management, as based on published expert consensus guidelines, field experience, and clinical trials. We also evaluate currently available and investigational treatments (including the use of antiviral agents), assess emerging monoclonal antibody therapies, and outline prospects for vaccine development. Finally, we discuss important infection prevention and control measures.

papers.title: Ecological Cascades and Future Hantavirus Spillover Risk in a Changing Climate
papers.abstract: Abstract Anthropogenic climate change is reshuffling global biodiversity and accelerating zoonotic spillover at the human-wildlife interface. The 2026 multi-country cruise ship outbreak of Andes virus highlights the unpredictable and globalized threat posed by rodent-borne orthohantaviruses, which cause severe, highly fatal human diseases worldwide. Despite this significant public health risk, macroecological synthesis linking environmental drivers to systemic shifts in hantavirus hazards has been lacking. Here, we implement an integrated ecological and machine learning framework combining 89 unique virus-host associations across 61 reservoir species with mechanistic Force-of-Infection (FOI) modeling to project global spillover hazards under current and future climate scenarios (SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5) for 2041–2060. Our models demonstrate a spatially uneven but geographically extensive expansion of spillover hazards, with approximately 74.9% of modeled land area experiencing an increase in FOI. We identify three distinct high-hazard belts heavily concentrated in already-temperate reservoir ranges: western and central North America, central and northeastern Europe extending into western Russia, and discrete patches within central South America. Crucially, our findings reveal that hantavirus hazards are fundamentally shaped along virus-specific ecological axes. While thermal and precipitation anomalies predominate the transmission dynamics of Old and New World lineages like Sin-Nombre virus and Thailand virus, distinct urban-centric Profiles emerge for Seoul virus and Mamore virus, driven explicitly by fine-scale anthropogenic landscape modifications. These results reveal that climate change will not simply intensify viral spillover uniformly but will fundamentally restructure it across varied climatic and human-dominated environments. Our maps provide a critical baseline for targeted global surveillance and highlight the urgent need to integrate spatial conservation planning with public health preparedness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2026 年多国游轮爆发的安第斯病毒凸显了啮齿动物传播的正汉坦病毒所带来的不可预测的全球性威胁,这种病毒在全世界范围内引起严重、高度致命的人类疾病。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 提供的证据没有明确说明研究设计、设置或研究人群。
elements_zh.methods: 在这里,我们实施了一个综合的生态和机器学习框架,将 61 个宿主物种的 89 个独特的病毒宿主关联与机械感染力 (FOI) 模型相结合,以预测 2041-2060 年当前和未来气候情景(SSP2-4.5 和 SSP5-8.5)下的全球溢出危害。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管存在重大公共卫生风险,但仍缺乏将环境驱动因素与汉坦病毒危害的系统性变化联系起来的宏观生态综合。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 虽然高温和降水异常主导了辛诺布雷病毒和泰国病毒等新旧世界谱系的传播动态,但首尔病毒和马莫雷病毒出现了独特的以城市为中心的特征,这明显是由精细尺度的人为景观改变驱动的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们的地图为有针对性的全球监测提供了关键基线,并强调了将空间保护规划与公共卫生准备相结合的迫切需要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些结果表明,气候变化不会简单地均匀加剧病毒溢出,而是会在不同的气候和人类主导的环境中从根本上重组病毒溢出。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 人为气候变化正在重新调整全球生物多样性,并加速人类与野生动物界面的人畜共患病溢出。2026 年多国游轮爆发的安第斯病毒凸显了啮齿动物传播的正汉坦病毒所带来的不可预测的全球性威胁,这种病毒在全世界范围内引起严重、高度致命的人类疾病。尽管存在重大公共卫生风险,但仍缺乏将环境驱动因素与汉坦病毒危害的系统性变化联系起来的宏观生态综合。在这里,我们实施了一个综合的生态和机器学习框架,将 61 个宿主物种的 89 个独特的病毒宿主关联与机械感染力 (FOI) 模型相结合,以预测 2041-2060 年当前和未来气候情景(SSP2-4.5 和 SSP5-8.5)下的全球溢出危害。我们的模型表明,溢出危害在空间上不均匀但在地理上广泛扩展,大约 74.9% 的模型土地面积经历了 FOI 的增加。我们确定了三个不同的高危险带,主要集中在已经温带的水库范围内:北美西部和中部、延伸到俄罗斯西部的欧洲中部和东北部以及南美洲中部境内的离散斑块。至关重要的是,我们的研究结果表明,汉坦病毒的危害从根本上是沿着病毒特定的生态轴形成的。虽然高温和降水异常主导了辛诺布雷病毒和泰国病毒等新旧世界谱系的传播动态,但首尔病毒和马莫雷病毒出现了独特的以城市为中心的特征,这明显是由精细尺度的人为景观改变驱动的。这些结果表明,气候变化不会简单地均匀加剧病毒溢出,而是会在不同的气候和人类主导的环境中从根本上重组病毒溢出。我们的地图为有针对性的全球监测提供了关键基线,并强调了将空间保护规划与公共卫生准备相结合的迫切需要。

papers.title: Hantavirus preparedness among undergraduate nursing students in the United Arab Emirates: a cross-sectional study of knowledge, risk perception and preventive practice.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Hantavirus infection is uncommon in many settings but can cause severe pulmonary or renal disease. Nursing students require disease-specific preparedness for exposure-history taking, safe prevention counselling and infection prevention during community and clinical learning. This study examined undergraduate nursing students' knowledge, risk perception and preventive practice toward hantavirus and identified associated factors. METHODS: A descriptive analytical cross-sectional survey was conducted among 236 undergraduate nursing students in one nursing program in Ras Al Khaimah, the United Arab Emirates during the 2025-2026 academic year. Data was collected using the researcher-developed Hantavirus Knowledge, Attitudes and Preventive Practices Questionnaire for Nursing Students (HKAPP-NS). Descriptive statistics, Cronbach's alpha, Pearson correlations and multivariable linear regression with HC3 robust standard errors were used. RESULTS: Knowledge was low among the 236 complete-case respondents (mean 8.13/20, SD 5.84), with 59.0% classified as having poor knowledge. Attitude was moderate (mean 33.34/50, SD 7.78), and overall practice was higher (mean 42.98/64, SD 15.83). Internal consistency was strong across domains (alpha 0.886-0.967). Attitude correlated with overall practice (r = 0.569, p < 0.001), whereas knowledge did not (r = 0.101, p = 0.120). Previous hantavirus teaching, infection prevention and control training and environmental exposure predicted higher knowledge. Attitude was the strongest independent predictor of overall practice. CONCLUSIONS: Students reported comparatively frequent precautionary practice but had important disease-specific knowledge gaps, particularly regarding safe rodent-contamination cleanup, routine vaccine availability, specific antiviral treatment and person-to-person transmission. The finding that attitude, rather than knowledge, independently predicted practice suggests that scenario-based One Health education should combine factual teaching with risk appraisal, self-efficacy building, exposure-history taking and prevention counselling to strengthen future nurses' preparedness for rodent-borne zoonotic infections.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:汉坦病毒感染在许多情况下并不常见,但可导致严重的肺部或肾脏疾病。护理专业的学生需要在社区和临床学习期间针对具体疾病做好暴露史记录、安全预防咨询和感染预防的准备。本研究调查了本科护生对汉坦病毒的知识、风险认知和预防实践,并确定了相关因素。方法:2025-2026 学年,对阿拉伯联合酋长国哈伊马角一个护理项目的 236 名护理本科生进行了一项描述性分析横断面调查。使用研究人员开发的护理学生汉坦病毒知识、态度和预防实践问卷(HKAPP-NS)收集数据。使用描述性统计、Cronbach's alpha、Pearson 相关性和具有 HC3 稳健标准误的多变量线性回归。结果:236 名完整案例受访者的知识水平较低(平均 8.13/20,标准差 5.84),其中 59.0% 的人知识水平较低。态度中等(平均 33.34/50,SD 7.78),总体实践较高(平均 42.98/64,SD 15.83)。跨领域的内部一致性很强(alpha 0.886-0.967)。态度与总体实践相关(r = 0.569,p < 0.001),而知识则不然(r = 0.101,p = 0.120)。以前的汉坦病毒教学、感染防控培训和环境暴露预示着更高的知识。态度是整体实践的最强独立预测因素。结论:学生报告了相对频繁的预防措施,但在特定疾病方面存在重大知识差距,特别是在安全啮齿动物污染清理、常规疫苗可用性、特定抗病毒治疗和人际传播方面。研究结果表明,态度而非知识独立预测了实践,这表明基于情景的“One Health”教育应将事实教学与风险评估、自我效能建设、接触史记录和预防咨询结合起来,以加强未来护士对啮齿动物传播的人畜共患感染的准备。

papers.title: Bleeding in haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome: A systematic review characterising the loss of haemostasis in hantavirus infections.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) is caused by hantaviruses and is associated with variable thrombocytopenia, coagulation abnormalities, and bleeding manifestations. While clinical features have been described in multiple studies, no previous systematic review has synthesised evidence on haemostatic dysfunction in HFRS. This review aimed to characterise the clinical and laboratory features of coagulation disturbances in HFRS to inform understanding of disease mechanisms and future research. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: We systematically searched MEDLINE, PubMed, CINAHL, Web of Science, and Scopus on 12 December 2024 for studies reporting clinical or laboratory evidence of haemostatic dysfunction in confirmed HFRS. The review protocol was prospectively registered on PROSPERO (CRD42024618760). Observational studies and case series meeting predefined inclusion criteria were eligible. Risk of bias was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal tools and, for one before-after cohort study, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) quality assessment tool. Studies were graded from 1 (lowest) to 3 (highest) based on methodological quality. Due to heterogeneity in study design and outcome reporting, meta-analysis was not feasible. Weighted averages were calculated for laboratory parameters, and data were visualised using bubble and bar plots. Fifty-five studies comprising 7,950 patients were included. Thrombocytopenia was the most consistent abnormality, typically more pronounced in infections with Hantaan (HTNV), Dobrava (DOBV), and Seoul (SEOV) viruses compared with Puumala (PUUV), which was associated with milder disease. Mild prolongation of activated partial thromboplastin time and elevated D-dimer were variably reported. Limited paediatric data suggested milder disease and less pronounced coagulation abnormalities. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: This review provides the first systematic synthesis of haemostatic dysfunction in HFRS. Findings highlight more severe thrombocytopenia and bleeding in HTNV, DOBV, and SEOV infections compared with PUUV. Variable study quality and incomplete reporting limit firm conclusions, underscoring the need for standardised, prospective studies of coagulation and bleeding outcomes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:肾综合征出血热(HFRS)由汉坦病毒引起,与不同程度的血小板减少、凝血异常和出血表现相关。虽然多项研究已经描述了临床特征,但之前没有系统评价综合 HFRS 止血功能障碍的证据。本综述旨在描述 HFRS 凝血障碍的临床和实验室特征,为了解疾病机制和未来研究提供信息。方法/主要发现:我们于 2024 年 12 月 12 日系统地检索了 MEDLINE、PubMed、CINAHL、Web of Science 和 Scopus,以查找报告确诊 HFRS 中止血功能障碍的临床或实验室证据的研究。该审查方案已在 PROSPERO 上前瞻性注册(CRD42024618760)。符合预定纳入标准的观察性研究和病例系列是合格的。使用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所 (JBI) 关键评估工具和美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 质量评估工具(对于一项前后队列研究)评估偏倚风险。根据方法学质量,研究从 1(最低)到 3(最高)分级。由于研究设计和结果报告的异质性,荟萃分析不可行。计算实验室参数的加权平均值,并使用气泡图和条形图可视化数据。纳入了 55 项研究,涉及 7,950 名患者。血小板减少症是最一致的异常,通常在汉坦 (HTNV)、多布拉瓦 (DOBV) 和首尔 (SEOV) 病毒感染中比普马拉 (PUUV) 病毒感染更为明显,后者与较轻的疾病相关。据报道,活化部分凝血活酶时间轻度延长,D-二聚体升高。有限的儿科数据表明疾病较轻,凝血异常不太明显。结论/意义:本综述首次系统总结了 HFRS 的止血功能障碍。研究结果强调,与 PUUV 相比,HTNV、DOBV 和 SEOV 感染的血小板减少和出血更为严重。研究质量参差不齐和报告不完整限制了确切的结论,强调了对凝血和出血结果进行标准化、前瞻性研究的必要性。

papers.title: Ribavirin post-exposure prophylaxis for Andes virus exposure: a viewpoint.
papers.abstract: Andes virus (ANDV) is unique among hantaviruses because person-to-person transmission is possible. This raises questions on the relevance of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), particularly following high-risk household, healthcare-associated, or laboratory exposures, considering its high case fatality rate. Ribavirin has demonstrated antiviral activity against hantaviruses in vitro and in animal models, although clinical evidence supporting its use for ANDV remains extremely limited. This viewpoint summarises the currently available evidence regarding ribavirin as PEP after potential ANDV exposure. We discuss the knowledge gaps that may limit the applicability of ribavirin PEP, to make informed decisions on the use of ribavirin in the setting of PEP. Potential dosing strategies are visualised by modelling and simulation, and potential dose and duration are discussed. Although the biological rationale for ribavirin PEP appears compelling, absence of controlled human studies and potential toxicity currently limit its role to highly selected exposure scenarios and use shortly after exposure.

papers.title: Can hantaviruses cause pandemics?
papers.abstract: Abstract The 2026 MV Hondius outbreak of Andes virus (ANDV) renewed concerns regarding the pandemic potential of hantaviruses, particularly because ANDV is the only hantavirus with proved human-to-human transmission. These concerns and fears are justified by the profound negative impact of the recent COVID-19 pandemic. Hantaviruses are segmented negative-sense RNA viruses maintained mainly in rodents and transmitted to man primarily through inhalation of contaminated aerosols. Hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome predominates in Europe and Asia, whereas hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome occurs in North and South Americas and carries high mortality. Although most hantaviruses have no human-to-human transmissibility, ANDV outbreaks demonstrate that transmission between humans is possible under close-contact conditions. Comparison with previous pandemics and WHO priority pathogens highlights several pandemic-associated features shared by hantaviruses, including zoonotic origin, RNA genome variability, and environmental influences. In this review, we will try to find the answer for the question “Can hantaviruses cause the next pandemic?”.

papers.title: Hantavirus and Middle East Public Health Challenges: A Subject Review
papers.abstract: Hantaviruses are emerging zoonotic viruses belonging to the family Hantaviridae, which are typically found in rodent reservoirs and transmitted to humans through contact with contaminated saliva, aerosolized particles or excreta. There are two major clinical syndromes associated with human infections: hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) — mostly reported from Europe and Asia, and hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) — mostly reported from the Americas. The Middle East has a relatively low incidence of hantavirus disease, but recent epidemiological studies have shown that the virus is circulating in several countries, including Türkiye and Iran. The emergence of hantavirus infections in this area has become a growing concern as the population increases, climate variations occur, the rodents' ecology is changing, the agriculture spreads and the surveillance of this situation is improving. There is limited surveillance, underdiagnosis, and a large clinical overlap with other febrile illnesses all of which are important challenges in quantifying the regional burden of disease. This review aims at summarizing the state of knowledge about the epidemiology of the hantavirus in the Middle East, focusing on geographical distribution, environmental factors, rodent hosts, epidemiology, clinical features, diagnostic methods and public health preparedness. Current data suggest that while human infections are rare, ecological conditions which could sustain hantavirus are present in several Middle Eastern countries, and therefore increased surveillance and research into interdisciplinary and One Health initiatives are needed. Creating closer ties between the medical, veterinary and environmental communities is crucial for early outbreak detection and prevention in the future.

papers.abstract_zh: 汉坦病毒是属于汉坦病毒科的新兴人畜共患病毒,通常存在于啮齿动物宿主中,并通过接触受污染的唾液、雾化颗粒或排泄物传播给人类。有两种与人类感染相关的主要临床综合征:肾综合征出血热(HFRS)——主要报告于欧洲和亚洲,以及汉坦病毒心肺综合征(HCPS)——主要报告于美洲。中东地区汉坦病毒病发病率相对较低,但最近的流行病学研究表明,该病毒正在包括土耳其和伊朗在内的多个国家传播。随着人口的增加、气候的变化、啮齿动物的生态环境的变化、农业的扩展以及对这种情况的监测的不断完善,该地区汉坦病毒感染的出现已引起越来越多的关注。监测有限、诊断不足以及与其他发热性疾病存在大量临床重叠,所有这些都是量化区域疾病负担的重要挑战。本综述旨在总结中东地区汉坦病毒流行病学的知识状况,重点关注地理分布、环境因素、啮齿动物宿主、流行病学、临床特征、诊断方法和公共卫生准备情况。目前的数据表明,虽然人类感染很少见,但一些中东国家存在可以维持汉坦病毒的生态条件,因此需要加强对跨学科和“同一个健康”倡议的监测和研究。在医疗、兽医和环境界之间建立更紧密的联系对于未来及早发现和预防疫情至关重要。

papers.title: Expedition cruises, island hopping, and zoonotic risk: governance and operational lessons from the MV Hondius Andes hantavirus outbreak
papers.abstract: The Andes orthohantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius expedition cruise illustrates how a probable land-based zoonotic exposure can become a multinational public health event when it intersects with enclosed shipboard environments, delayed clinical recognition, remote navigation, medical evacuation, and international passenger dispersal. Although hantavirus infection is classically associated with exposure to infected rodents or contaminated environments, Andes virus is exceptional among orthohantaviruses because limited person-to-person transmission has been documented, particularly after close and prolonged contact. This Perspective uses the MV Hondius outbreak as an analytical case study to identify governance and operational gaps in expedition-era travel medicine. Existing International Health Regulations, WHO ship-event guidance, and ECDC recommendations provide essential foundations for coordination, notification, isolation, and contact tracing; however, this outbreak exposed expedition-specific gaps in safe port access, medical evacuation, onboard recognition of nonspecific febrile illness, diagnostic escalation, passenger traceability, and post-disembarkation monitoring. We therefore propose an accountability-oriented One Health preparedness model that operationalizes existing guidance through route-level risk assessment, exposure-history assessment, onboard syndromic surveillance, isolation and telemedicine triggers, reference-laboratory pathways, port-of-call agreements, auditable passenger and excursion records, and cross-border post-travel monitoring. The central lesson is not that expedition cruises, birdwatching, or ecological tourism are inherently unsafe, but that their expanding geographic reach requires binding, auditable, and expedition-specific outbreak protocols before passengers embark.

Although hantavirus infection is classically associated with exposure to infected rodents or contaminated environments, Andes virus is exceptional among orthohantaviruses because limited person-to-person transmission has been documented, particularly after close and prolonged contact. This Perspective uses the MV Hondius outbreak as an analytical case study to identify governance and operational gaps in expedition-era travel medicine. Existing International Health Regulations, WHO ship-event guidance, and ECDC recommendations provide essential foundations for coordination, notification, isolation, and contact tracing; however, this outbreak exposed expedition-specific gaps in safe port access, medical evacuation, onboard recognition of nonspecific febrile illness, diagnostic escalation, passenger traceability, and post-disembarkation monitoring. We therefore propose an accountability-oriented One Health preparedness model that operationalizes existing guidance through route-level risk assessment, exposure-history assessment, onboard syndromic surveillance, isolation and telemedicine triggers, reference-laboratory pathways, port-of-call agreements, auditable passenger and excursion records, and cross-border post-travel monitoring. The central lesson is not that expedition cruises, birdwatching, or ecological tourism are inherently unsafe, but that their expanding geographic reach requires binding, auditable, and expedition-specific outbreak protocols before passengers embark.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal correlation analysis between climate change and hantavirus outbreak in Argentina: Quantitative causal inference based on Google Earth Engine and Bayesian spatiotemporal regression
papers.abstract: Objective: The number of confirmed cases of Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) in Argentina surged to 101 in the 2025–2026 epidemic season, nearly doubling from the previous season. There was a significant geographical shift in the epicenter of the epidemic from the traditional Patagonian region to the province of Buenos Aires and the NOA region (Salta, Jujuy) in the northwest. This study aims to use the Google Earth Engine (GEE) cloud platform to integrate ERA5 reanalysis climate data and NOAA surface observation data, construct a Bayesian spatiotemporal hierarchy model, and quantitatively analyze the spatiotemporal correlation and causal path between climate anomalies (high temperature, drought, heavy rainfall) and hantavirus outbreaks. Methods: The data of confirmed cases of HPS from 2020 to 2026, released by the Argentine Ministry of Health (SNVS 2.0), WHO, and PAHO, were collected, and the geographical coordinates and time of onset of HPS were extracted. The ERA5-Land hourly dataset (0.1°×0.1° resolution) and NOAA Global Surface Summary of the Day (GSOD) site data were called by GEE to calculate the monthly temperature anomalies (TA), Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI), and Soil Moisture Anomaly (SMA), and frequency of extreme weather events. Bayesian Spatiotemporal Poisson Regression (Bayesian Spatiotemporal Poisson Regression) combined with the INLA (Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation) method was used to estimate the lag effect (lag of 1–6 months) and spatial heterogeneity of climate factors on the onset of HPS. Causal Mediation Analysis was used to identify the causal chains of "climate anomalies→ vegetation productivity→ rodent population expansion→ human exposure". Results: The spatial distribution of HPS cases in the 2025–2026 season showed significant unstable characteristics (Moran's I = 0.42, p 1.5), while outbreaks in NOA were closely related to sudden heavy rainfall ("drought-flood" compound extreme events) after persistent drought. Causal mediation analysis showed that the vegetation index (NDVI) played a significant mediating effect between climate anomalies and HPS risk (41.2% in Buenos Aires and 56.7% in the NOA region). Conclusion: This study realizes the quantitative causal inference of climate anomalies and hantavirus outbreaks at the national scale in Argentina for the first time, and confirms the causal pathway of the "drought-flood" compound extreme climate event driving rodent population expansion and human exposure risk increase through the trophic cascade. The GEE-based real-time monitoring framework can provide a methodological basis for the establishment of the HPS Climate-Driven Early Warning System in Argentina.

This study aims to use the Google Earth Engine (GEE) cloud platform to integrate ERA5 reanalysis climate data and NOAA surface observation data, construct a Bayesian spatiotemporal hierarchy model, and quantitatively analyze the spatiotemporal correlation and causal path between climate anomalies (high temperature, drought, heavy rainfall) and hantavirus outbreaks. Methods: The data of confirmed cases of HPS from 2020 to 2026, released by the Argentine Ministry of Health (SNVS 2.0), WHO, and PAHO, were collected, and the geographical coordinates and time of onset of HPS were extracted. The ERA5-Land hourly dataset (0.1°×0.1° resolution) and NOAA Global Surface Summary of the Day (GSOD) site data were called by GEE to calculate the monthly temperature anomalies (TA), Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI), and Soil Moisture Anomaly (SMA), and frequency of extreme weather events. Bayesian Spatiotemporal Poisson Regression (Bayesian Spatiotemporal Poisson Regression) combined with the INLA (Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation) method was used to estimate the lag effect (lag of 1–6 months) and spatial heterogeneity of climate factors on the onset of HPS. Causal Mediation Analysis was used to identify the causal chains of "climate anomalies→ vegetation productivity→ rodent population expansion→ human exposure". Results: The spatial distribution of HPS cases in the 2025–2026 season showed significant unstable characteristics (Moran's I = 0.42, p 1.5), while outbreaks in NOA were closely related to sudden heavy rainfall ("drought-flood" compound extreme events) after persistent drought. Causal mediation analysis showed that the vegetation index (NDVI) played a significant mediating effect between climate anomalies and HPS risk (41.2% in Buenos Aires and 56.7% in the NOA region). Conclusion: This study realizes the quantitative causal inference of climate anomalies and hantavirus outbreaks at the national scale in Argentina for the first time, and confirms the causal pathway of the "drought-flood" compound extreme climate event driving rodent population expansion and human exposure risk increase through the trophic cascade. The GEE-based real-time monitoring framework can provide a methodological basis for the establishment of the HPS Climate-Driven Early Warning System in Argentina.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) cases in Argentina rose to 101 in the 2025–2026 season, nearly doubling from the prior season, with a marked geographical shift from Patagonia to Buenos Aires and the northwest NOA region. The study sought to quantify the spatiotemporal correlation and causal pathways between climate anomalies and hantavirus outbreaks using advanced geospatial and statistical tools.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed confirmed HPS cases from 2020 to 2026 reported by Argentine health authorities and international organizations, extracting onset dates and geographic coordinates. Climate data were integrated via the Google Earth Engine platform using ERA5-Land and NOAA GSOD datasets.
analysis.methods: Monthly climate anomalies (temperature, precipitation, soil moisture) and extreme weather frequencies were calculated using ERA5-Land and NOAA GSOD data accessed through Google Earth Engine. A Bayesian spatiotemporal Poisson regression with INLA estimated lag effects (1–6 months) and spatial heterogeneity, while causal mediation analysis identified the pathway from climate anomalies to human exposure via vegetation productivity and rodent population expansion.
analysis.main_results: The 2025–2026 HPS cases showed unstable spatial distribution (Moran's I = 0.42, p < 0.05), with outbreaks in NOA linked to drought-flood compound events following persistent drought. Vegetation index (NDVI) mediated 41.2% of the climate–HPS risk in Buenos Aires and 56.7% in NOA.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that drought-flood compound climate events drive hantavirus outbreaks through a trophic cascade involving vegetation productivity and rodent population expansion, representing the first national-scale quantitative causal inference of this relationship in Argentina.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the development of a GEE-based real-time monitoring framework for an HPS Climate-Driven Early Warning System in Argentina, enabling proactive public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on ecological associations and modeled climate data, which may not fully capture local transmission dynamics or unmeasured confounders, limiting causal inference strength to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the spatiotemporal link between climate anomalies and hantavirus outbreaks in Argentina during 2020–2026, focusing on the 2025–2026 epidemic season when cases nearly doubled and shifted geographically from Patagonia to Buenos Aires and the NOA region. Using Google Earth Engine, ERA5-Land and NOAA GSOD data were integrated to compute monthly climate anomalies and extreme weather frequencies. A Bayesian spatiotemporal Poisson regression with INLA estimated lagged and spatially heterogeneous effects of climate factors on HPS onset, while causal mediation analysis quantified the pathway from climate anomalies to human exposure via vegetation productivity and rodent population expansion. The 2025–2026 HPS cases exhibited unstable spatial clustering, and outbreaks in NOA were associated with drought-flood compound events following prolonged drought. Vegetation index mediated a substantial proportion of climate–HPS risk in Buenos Aires (41.2%) and NOA (56.7%). The authors interpret these findings as evidence that compound climate events drive outbreaks through ecological cascades, marking the first national-scale quantitative causal inference of this relationship. The study proposes a GEE-based early warning system to guide public health responses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025-2026 年季节,阿根廷的汉坦病毒肺综合征 (HPS) 病例增至 101 例,几乎是上一季节的两倍,地理分布明显从巴塔哥尼亚转移到布宜诺斯艾利斯和 NOA 西北部地区。该研究试图利用先进的地理空间和统计工具来量化气候异常与汉坦病毒爆发之间的时空相关性和因果路径。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了阿根廷卫生当局和国际组织报告的 2020 年至 2026 年确诊的 HPS 病例,提取了发病日期和地理坐标。气候数据通过 Google Earth Engine 平台使用 ERA5-Land 和 NOAA GSOD 数据集进行整合。
elements_zh.methods: 使用通过 Google Earth Engine 访问的 ERA5-Land 和 NOAA GSOD 数据计算每月气候异常(温度、降水、土壤湿度)和极端天气频率。贝叶斯时空泊松回归与 INLA 估计滞后效应(1-6 个月)和空间异质性,而因果中介分析确定了从气候异常到人类暴露通过植被生产力和啮齿动物种群扩张的途径。
elements_zh.main_results: 2025-2026 年 HPS 病例表现出不稳定的空间分布(Moran's I = 0.42,p < 0.05),NOA 的爆发与持续干旱后的旱涝复合事件有关。植被指数 (NDVI) 介导了布宜诺斯艾利斯 41.2% 的气候 HPS 风险和 NOA 的 56.7%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,旱涝复合气候事件通过涉及植被生产力和啮齿动物种群扩张的营养级联驱动汉坦病毒爆发,这是阿根廷首次对这种关系进行全国范围的定量因果推断。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持为阿根廷 HPS 气候驱动预警系统开发基于 GEE 的实时监测框架,从而实现主动的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于生态关联和模拟气候数据,这些数据可能无法完全捕捉当地的传播动态或无法测量的混杂因素,从而将因果推理强度限制为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:2025-2026年流行季,阿根廷汉坦病毒肺综合征(HPS)确诊病例激增至101例,比上一季增加近一倍。疫情震中发生了显着的地理转移,从传统的巴塔哥尼亚地区转移到布宜诺斯艾利斯省和西北部的NOA地区(萨尔塔、胡胡伊)。本研究旨在利用Google Earth Engine(GEE)云平台整合ERA5再分析气候数据和NOAA地面观测数据,构建贝叶斯时空层次模型,定量分析气候异常(高温、干旱、强降雨)与汉坦病毒爆发之间的时空相关性和因果路径。方法:收集阿根廷卫生部(SNVS 2.0)、WHO、PAHO发布的2020年至2026年HPS确诊病例数据,提取HPS的地理坐标和发病时间。GEE调用ERA5-Land逐时数据集(0.1°×0.1°分辨率)和NOAA全球地表日概要(GSOD)站点数据计算月度气温距平(TA)、标准化降水指数(SPI)、土壤湿度距平(SMA)以及极端天气事件发生频率。采用贝叶斯时空泊松回归(Bayesian Spatiotemporal Poisson Regression)结合INLA(Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation)方法估计气候因素对HPS爆发的滞后效应(滞后1~6个月)和空间异质性。因果中介分析用于识别“气候异常→植被生产力→啮齿动物种群扩张→人类暴露”的因果链。结果:2025-2026年季节HPS病例的空间分布表现出显着的不稳定特征(Moran's I=0.42,p=1.5),而NOA的暴发与持续干旱后突发强降雨(“旱涝”复合极端事件)密切相关。因果中介分析表明,植被指数(NDVI)在气候异常与HPS风险之间发挥显着中介作用(布宜诺斯艾利斯为41.2%,NOA地区为56.7%)。结论:本研究首次实现了阿根廷全国范围内气候异常与汉坦病毒爆发的定量因果推断,并证实了“旱涝”复合极端气候事件通过营养级联驱动啮齿动物种群扩张和人类暴露风险增加的因果路径。基于GEE的实时监测框架可以为阿根廷建立HPS气候驱动预警系统提供方法基础。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 2025-2026 年季节,阿根廷的汉坦病毒肺综合征 (HPS) 病例增至 101 例,几乎是上一季节的两倍,地理分布明显从巴塔哥尼亚转移到布宜诺斯艾利斯和 NOA 西北部地区。该研究试图利用先进的地理空间和统计工具来量化气候异常与汉坦病毒爆发之间的时空相关性和因果路径。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了阿根廷卫生当局和国际组织报告的 2020 年至 2026 年确诊的 HPS 病例,提取了发病日期和地理坐标。气候数据通过 Google Earth Engine 平台使用 ERA5-Land 和 NOAA GSOD 数据集进行整合。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用通过 Google Earth Engine 访问的 ERA5-Land 和 NOAA GSOD 数据计算每月气候异常(温度、降水、土壤湿度)和极端天气频率。贝叶斯时空泊松回归与 INLA 估计滞后效应(1-6 个月)和空间异质性,而因果中介分析确定了从气候异常到人类暴露通过植被生产力和啮齿动物种群扩张的途径。
analysis_zh.main_results: 2025-2026 年 HPS 病例表现出不稳定的空间分布(Moran's I = 0.42,p < 0.05),NOA 的爆发与持续干旱后的旱涝复合事件有关。植被指数 (NDVI) 介导了布宜诺斯艾利斯 41.2% 的气候 HPS 风险和 NOA 的 56.7%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,旱涝复合气候事件通过涉及植被生产力和啮齿动物种群扩张的营养级联驱动汉坦病毒爆发,这是阿根廷首次对这种关系进行全国范围的定量因果推断。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持为阿根廷 HPS 气候驱动预警系统开发基于 GEE 的实时监测框架,从而实现主动的公共卫生干预措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于生态关联和模拟气候数据,这些数据可能无法完全捕捉当地的传播动态或无法测量的混杂因素,从而将因果推理强度限制为中等。

papers.title: Modeling the Transmission Dynamics of Hantavirus with Environmental Viral Persistence
papers.abstract: Hantavirus is a zoonotic infection maintained principally in rodent reservoirs, and human exposure occurs mainly through environments contaminated with infectious viral particles. This study formulates and analyses a deterministic compartmental model for hantavirus transmission involving susceptible and infected rodents, susceptible, exposed, infectious and recovered humans, and an environmental viral reservoir. The model includes logistic rodent growth, direct rodent-to-rodent transmission, indirect environmental transmission, viral shedding from infected classes and natural viral clearance. Fundamental qualitative properties of the system are established, including existence, uniqueness, positivity and boundedness of solutions within a feasible region. The disease-free equilibrium is obtained, and the basic reproduction number is derived using the next-generation matrix method. Stability analysis shows that the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable when R0 1 and the existence of a biologically feasible endemic equilibrium. Local stability conditions for the endemic equilibrium are characterised through the Jacobian matrix and the Routh-Hurwitz criterion. The analysis indicates that environmental viral persistence provides an indirect pathway that can sustain transmission between infected rodents, susceptible rodents and humans. These findings suggest that reducing rodent infection, limiting environmental contamination and increasing viral clearance may help move the system below the epidemic threshold. The model offers a mathematically tractable framework for interpreting hantavirus persistence and for guiding future extensions involving seasonality, spatial structure, stochasticity and data-driven parameterisation.

papers.abstract_zh: 汉坦病毒是一种人畜共患感染,主要存在于啮齿动物宿主中,人类暴露主要是通过被传染性病毒颗粒污染的环境发生的。本研究制定并分析了汉坦病毒传播的确定性区室模型,涉及易感和受感染的啮齿动物、易感、暴露、感染和康复的人类以及环境病毒库。该模型包括逻辑啮齿动物生长、啮齿动物之间的直接传播、间接环境传播、感染类别的病毒脱落和自然病毒清除。建立了系统的基本定性属性,包括可行区域内解的存在性、唯一性、正性和有界性。获得无病平衡,并利用下一代矩阵法推导出基本繁殖数。稳定性分析表明,当 R0 1 且存在生物学上可行的地方性平衡时,无病平衡是局部和全局渐近稳定的。地方性平衡的局部稳定性条件通过雅可比矩阵和劳斯-赫尔维茨准则来表征。分析表明,环境病毒的持续存在提供了一种间接途径,可以维持受感染的啮齿动物、易感啮齿动物和人类之间的传播。这些发现表明,减少啮齿动物感染、限制环境污染和增加病毒清除可能有助于将系统控制在流行阈值以下。该模型提供了一个数学上易于处理的框架,用于解释汉坦病毒的持久性,并指导未来涉及季节性、空间结构、随机性和数据驱动的参数化的扩展。

papers.title: Metatranscriptomics reveals urbanization-driven divergence in rodent viromes and zoonotic risks in Chinese megacities.
papers.abstract: Metagenomic sequencing has advanced our understanding of wildlife-associated viruses and enabled identification of potential zoonotic pathogens. However, most studies remain geographically limited, with few systematic comparisons of virome compositions across urbanization gradients. To address this gap, we conducted large-scale sampling in two densely populated Chinese megacities-Wuhan and Shenzhen-with distinct climates. We collected 1,072 rodents from four species that frequently interact with humans, enabling comparative analysis of urban rectal virome dynamics and zoonotic risks in rodents. We identified 35 vertebrate-associated viruses. Among them, 9 were potentially novel species, including Norovirus and Orthopicobirnavirus species, and 3 had zoonotic potential, namely Orthohantavirus seoulense and human coronavirus OC43 (HCoV_OC43). We also discovered two viruses previously unreported in rodents, Erinaceus hedgehog Seoul orthohantavirus and Canine astrovirus, which revealed cross-order transmission risk. Additionally, 22 high-risk viruses were identified, with Wuhan and Shenzhen showing distinct prevalence patterns. Our analysis shows that inter-city rectal virome divergence is structured by meteorological variables, independently explaining 5.0% of the variation in viral community composition. Our findings highlight the importance of spatial distance in shaping the distribution and transmission of rodent-borne viruses. These insights are essential for proactive surveillance and mitigation of emerging zoonotic threats in high-density urban environments.

papers.source_body_en: Metagenomic sequencing has advanced our understanding of wildlife-associated viruses and enabled identification of potential zoonotic pathogens. papers.abstract_zh: 宏基因组测序增进了我们对野生动物相关病毒的理解,并能够识别潜在的人畜共患病原体。然而,大多数研究仍然局限于地理范围,很少对不同城市化梯度的病毒组组成进行系统比较。为了解决这一差距,我们在两个人口稠密、气候不同的大城市——武汉和深圳进行了大规模采样。我们收集了来自四个经常与人类互动的物种的 1,072 只啮齿动物,从而能够对啮齿动物的城市直肠病毒动态和人畜共患病风险进行比较分析。我们鉴定出 35 种与脊椎动物相关的病毒。其中,9个潜在新种,包括诺如病毒和正双核病毒属,3个具有人畜共患潜力,即汉城正汉坦病毒和人类冠状病毒OC43(HCoV_OC43)。我们还在啮齿动物中发现了两种以前未报告的病毒,即刺猬首尔正汉坦病毒和犬星状病毒,这揭示了跨目传播的风险。此外,还发现了 22 种高风险病毒,其中武汉和深圳表现出不同的流行模式。我们的分析表明,城市间直肠病毒组差异是由气象变量构成的,独立解释了病毒群落组成变异的 5.0%。我们的研究结果强调了空间距离在影响啮齿动物传播病毒的分布和传播方面的重要性。这些见解对于主动监测和缓解高密度城市环境中新出现的人畜共患威胁至关重要。

papers.title: Research on Mathematical Modeling of Infectious Disease Spread on Cruise Ships
papers.abstract: Cruise ships, characterized by high density, enclosed environments and shared facilities, have become amplifiers for infectious disease outbreaks; however, predicting transmission in such settings remains challenging due to small initial case numbers. In this study, a mathematical modeling framework—including compartmental, small-world (SW), and scale-free (SF) network models—was developed to analyze the dynamics of hantavirus and norovirus transmission on recent cruise ship outbreaks. The results show that when the initial number of exposed or infected individuals is extremely small (e.g., 1–2 persons), disease spread is dominated by stochasticity, causing substantial variation between individual simulations and mean model predictions. Notably, SF networks exhibited lower transmission risk under these conditions, contradicting the theoretical expectation that when the population is large, SF networks facilitate the spread of disease. The compartmental model, while consistent with average simulation outcomes, failed to reliably predict any single outbreak event. In conclusion, for closed environments such as cruise ships with very few initial cases, stochastic variability is essential, and single-outbreak outcomes should be understood as highly contingent rather than deterministically predictable.

papers.abstract_zh: 邮轮以其高密度、封闭环境、共用设施等特点,成为传染病爆发的放大器;然而,由于初始病例数较少,预测这种情况下的传播仍然具有挑战性。在这项研究中,开发了一个数学建模框架——包括隔室、小世界(SW)和无标度(SF)网络模型——来分析最近游轮爆发中汉坦病毒和诺如病毒传播的动态。结果表明,当初始暴露或感染个体数量极少(例如 1-2 人)时,疾病传播以随机性为主,导致个体模拟与平均模型预测之间存在巨大差异。值得注意的是,SF 网络在这些条件下表现出较低的传播风险,这与人口较多时 SF 网络促进疾病传播的理论预期相矛盾。分区模型虽然与平均模拟结果一致,但未能可靠地预测任何单一爆发事件。总之,对于初始病例很少的游轮等封闭环境,随机变异至关重要,单次疫情爆发的结果应被理解为高度偶然的结果,而不是确定性的可预测结果。

But while it was serious, the WHO said it assesses the public health risk as low. WHO has now informed the 12 countries whose nationals disembarked the cruise ship MV Hondius earlier during the voyage at the remote British territory of Saint Helena in the South Atlantic Ocean. Those 12 countries are Canada, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkyie, the United Kingdom and the United States of America. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, said in a media briefing in Geneva that the agency currently expects the outbreak to remain limited if appropriate public health measures are implemented quickly and effectively. He, however, warned that additional cases remain possible as authorities continue tracing exposed passengers and contacts across multiple countries. WHO said around 2,500 hantavirus diagnostic kits are being shipped from laboratories in Argentina to five countries. The Dutch Foreign Ministry has confirmed that around 40 passengers from the cruise ship hit by a deadly hantavirus outbreak disembarked at the island of St. Helena. However, ship operator Oceanwide Expeditions said 29 passengers left the MV Hondius on the 24th of April. analysis.time: The WHO confirmed the five hantavirus cases on May 7, 2026, while the article was published on July 18, 2026. The event involves passengers disembarking from the MV Hondius on April 24, 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: The outbreak occurred on the cruise ship MV Hondius, which docked at Saint Helena, a remote British territory in the South Atlantic Ocean. Affected populations include passengers from 12 countries: Canada, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Singapore, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
analysis.event: The World Health Organization (WHO) confirmed five hantavirus cases linked to a cruise ship outbreak, with three additional cases suspected. The WHO informed the 12 countries whose nationals disembarked from the ship.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Five confirmed cases and three suspected cases have been reported. The WHO assesses the public health risk as low but warns that additional cases are possible as authorities trace exposed passengers and contacts across multiple countries. Approximately 40 passengers disembarked at St. Helena, though the ship operator stated 29 passengers left on April 24. Diagnostic kits are being shipped to five countries.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The WHO is coordinating with 12 countries and shipping diagnostic kits. The Dutch Foreign Ministry has confirmed passenger disembarkation. The ship operator provided passenger numbers. The WHO expects the outbreak to remain limited if public health measures are effective but notes uncertainty due to ongoing contact tracing.

French Health Minister Stephanie Rist confirmed this today. The woman was among five French nationals evacuated from the cruise ship and repatriated to France yesterday, developing symptoms during the repatriation flight. Rist said the woman’s condition worsened overnight, and she was transferred to a specialised infectious disease hospital for treatment. The minister also announced that 22 close contacts of Hantavirus cases had been identified in France and ordered to isolate. Earlier, French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu had said the five French passengers who arrived in France yesterday afternoon aboard a medical evacuation flight were immediately placed under strict isolation until further notice. He added that they were receiving medical care and would undergo tests and health assessments. According to the World Health Organization, Hantaviruses are zoonotic viruses that naturally infect rodents and are occasionally transmitted to humans. news.content_title: INO, MRNA, NVAX, EBS Jump Overnight: Trump Promises Full Hantavirus Report As Deadly Outbreak Sparks Vaccine Rally
news.content: Shares of vaccine makers and biodefense companies rallied overnight on Friday after U.S. President Donald Trump addressed a deadly hantavirus outbreak aboard a cruise ship and promised a full update on the situation. Overnight, Emergent BioSolutions (EBS) climbed 3%, while Inovio Pharmaceuticals (INO) and Novavax (NVAX) each gained 2% and Moderna (MRNA) rose 1%. Trump said late Thursday that the administration was closely studying the outbreak from the Dutch-flagged cruise ship Hondius, where three passengers have died and several others became infected. “It’s very much, we hope, under control,” Trump said, adding that a full report will be released on Friday. The outbreak has triggered six confirmed infections and additional suspected cases aboard the vessel, which had 150 passengers onboard during an Atlantic voyage from Argentina toward Europe. Authorities are still investigating how the virus spread on board. Singapore has already isolated two passengers from the ship due to concerns about possible exposure during the trip. The World Health Organization (WHO) also issued an alert on the outbreak, although officials said that the global risk remains low and that hantavirus is less transmissible than COVID-19 or influenza. The virus involved is said to be the Andes strain, one of the few hantavirus variants associated with limited human-to-human transmission. Moderna is viewed as one of the U.S. government’s key vaccine platforms for outbreaks. Since 2023, the company has worked with Korea University’s Vaccine Innovation Center on an mRNA-based hantavirus vaccine candidate, with preclinical studies earlier this year showing protection against hantavirus infection in mice. In 2024, Moderna received a $176 million award backed by the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA) in 2024 for the development of mRNA-based pandemic influenza vaccines and outbreak preparedness programs. Moderna’s partnership with the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) is also in focus, which previously said mRNA could help shorten vaccine-development timelines to as little as 100 days during outbreaks. Inovio, meanwhile, has the clearest hantavirus link among the stocks rallying overnight. The company previously participated in several hantavirus DNA vaccine studies targeting Hantaan, Puumala and Andes hantavirus strains. One National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases-backed study evaluated an Andes virus DNA vaccine to prevent hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, while another U.S. Army-supported study examined mixed hantavirus DNA vaccines. While none of Inovio’s hantavirus vaccine programs produced a commercial product, the outbreak revived speculative interest in companies with prior hantavirus research. Investors frequently rotate into Novavax during virus headlines due to the company’s vaccine-development platform and history of rapidly developing candidates for pathogens such as Ebola, MERS and Zika. The company’s protein-based nanoparticle platform and Matrix-M adjuvant tech can generate vaccine candidates against emerging infectious diseases, already used in marketed COVID-19 and malaria vaccines. Emergent BioSolutions, on the other hand, is often viewed as one of the U.S. government’s primary biodefense and medical-countermeasure contractors during public-health emergencies. The company has existing relationships with BARDA and makes products based on Anthrax, Ebola, smallpox, mpox and viral hemorrhagic fevers. Emergent previously received BARDA task orders for viral hemorrhagic fever therapeutics and has also participated in manufacturing efforts during outbreaks, including Ebola and Zika. On Stocktwits, retail sentiment for INO and NVAX was ‘extremely bullish’ amid ‘extremely high’ message volume, while MRNA saw ‘bullish’ sentiment with ‘high’ message volume. EBS also recorded ‘extremely bullish’ sentiment, though message volume remained ‘normal.’ Over the past year, MRNA has surged 102%, followed by EBS up 93% and NVAX higher by 55%, while INO has declined 22%. Datadog, Inc.’s stock (DDOG) is on track to notch its best weekly performance on record as the cloud company delivered a breakout first-quarter (Q1) earnings that ignited investor enthusiasm and underscored its key role in the artificial intelligence infrastructure boom. The stock is also set to be the biggest winner this week on the Nasdaq-100 and the second-best performer on the S&P 500. Jefferies, Stifel and Evercore ISI all raised their price targets on Datadog after what analysts broadly described as a solid “beat and raise” quarter. The firms cited stronger-than-anticipated demand, improving guidance and continued momentum in both core and AI-related products. Jefferies raised its price target on DDOG to $210 from $170 and kept a ‘Buy’ rating, according to TheFly. The firm said customer usage grew at its fastest rate since early 2022, showing strong momentum in its main platform services. Stifel made a more aggressive revision, raising its target to $305 from $160 and also reiterating a ‘Buy’ rating. The firm emphasized that revenue growth continued to pick up sequentially. The new price target implies a 61% upside from the stock’s closing price on Thursday. Evercore ISI also raised its price target to $225 from $175, maintaining an Outperform rating. The firm said the company’s quarterly results and forward guidance helped ease concerns that growth might slow later in the year. Datadog stock traded over 1% lower overnight late Thursday, after surging over 31% in the regular session. In Q1, Datadog posted revenue of $1.006 billion, reaching its first-ever billion-dollar mark and beating analyst expectations of $959.9 million. Adjusted earnings per share came in at $0.60, well above the $0.51 Street forecast, according to Fiscal AI data. The company continued to deepen its enterprise base, growing to roughly 4,550 customers generating more than $100,000 in annual recurring revenue, up from about 3,770 a year earlier. Looking ahead, the company sees Q2 revenue between $1.07 billion and $1.08 billion and EPS between $0.57 and $0.59, compared with the Street estimates of $1.06 billion and $0.58, respectively. On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around the stock remained in ‘extremely bullish’ territory with 1,377% surge in message volume over 24 hours. A user said, “$DDOG earnings just proved high-value SaaS isn’t dying because of AI, it’s accelerating.” Another user said, “damn, I missed this one. Crushing growth with expanding margins.” DDOG stock has gained over 38% year-to-date. CoreWeave, Inc. forecast second-quarter revenue below analysts’ expectations and said its capital expenditure this year would be higher than previously forecast due to increasing component prices, triggering a selloff in shares. Still, retail traders returned upbeat, citing growth prospects and calling the dip an overreaction. CRWV dropped 10% in overnight trading heading into Friday. If the move holds in the regular session, it would mark the worst single-day drop in about a month. CoreWeave’s quarterly report forced investors to reassess their outlook on the company, as strong revenue and order growth were accompanied by sharply rising expenses. In recent months, Meta Platforms committed $21 billion for CoreWeave’s cloud capacity through 2032, with the cloud operator also signing new multi-billion-dollar deals with Anthropic and Jane Street. Demand for the so-called neocloud providers such as CoreWeave and Nebius has surged over the last year as tech companies race to secure the hardware and cloud capacity to support AI development and user growth. Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta, and Nvidia are among CoreWeave's largest customers. The company’s total revenue surged 105% to $2.08 billion in the first quarter, beating analysts’ estimate of $1.97 billion from LSEG/Reuters. Operating expenses more than doubled to $2.22 billion, a result of continuing to scale active power capacity. Backlog, which denotes orders booked but not yet realized as revenue, jumped to $99.4 billion as of March 31, compared with $66.8 billion at the end of December. Last quarter, CoreWeave added more than 400 megawatts of contracted power, bringing its total to more than 3.5 gigawatts. For Q2, the company expects revenue in the range of $2.45 billion to $2.6 billion, below analysts' estimate of $2.69 billion. The focus item, still, was the capital expenditure. Not only did CoreWeave's capex increased 90% sequentially to $7.70 billion in Q1, but the company also said the 2026 figure would be slightly higher. The company now expects full-year capital expenditures in a range of $31 billion to $35 billion, up from a previous low end of $30 billion. “In the last six, nine months, there has been an acute shortage of certain components that have moved up,” CEO Michael Intrator said on the analyst call, adding that the structure of its supply contracts offers the company some insulation from price volatility. On Stocktwits, the retail sentiment for CRWV flipped to ‘extremely bullish’ from ‘neutral’ the previous day. “Buying Coreweave now is similar to buying csco in 1989 or cell tower company AMT in 2001 at 1.00,” a trader said, signaling that it's still early days for neocloud companies and the upside potential is huge. “Everybody is worried about today's debt. Well 8 years ago the Oilers gave McDavid 12 million a year. Today that contract looks mighty savy... I think it's bullcrap this stock will be fine with NVDA backing and Blackstone owning notes.” Another wrote: “CoreWeave’s sell-off is a market misread. The business isn’t demand-constrained — the $99.4B backlog proves that.” Still, some traders remained concerned of the growing leverage and bottom-line pressure, with one saying, “losses and debt. As of April 15, the company reported 2.64 million stock options and 2.26 million restricted stock units outstanding, with total equity overhang representing 2.6% of total float. Investors are focused on Sellas’ Phase 3 Regal study evaluating Galinpepimut-S, or GPS, as a maintenance therapy for AML patients whose disease returned but later went back into remission. The event-driven study is approaching the 80 overall-survival-event threshold required to trigger topline analysis. news.content_title: RCL, NCLH, CCL: Cruise Stocks Get Hit As Rare Hantavirus Outbreak Sparks Travel Fears
news.content: U.S. cruise stocks, including Carnival (CCL), Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH), and Royal Caribbean (RCL), all slipped overnight, causing investor concern after a sudden health scare linked to a South Atlantic voyage rattled confidence in an already sensitivity-prone travel sector. A luxury cruise voyage has turned into a major health incident after a hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius led to three deaths and growing international concern. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), a cluster of acute respiratory illness cases was first flagged on May 2, involving passengers on a cruise ship carrying 147 people. The vessel, which departed Ushuaia, Argentina, in early April, has been anchored off Cabo Verde as authorities coordinate response efforts. WHO noted that symptoms among affected passengers developed between April 6 and April 28, beginning with fever and gastrointestinal distress before rapidly escalating into pneumonia, respiratory failure, and shock in severe cases. WHO said hantaviruses usually spread through infected rodents or contaminated areas. In rare cases, the Andes strain can spread between people in close-contact settings such as shared cabins. Despite the severity of the onboard outbreak, the WHO continues to assess the overall global risk as low. Although global risk assessments remain low, the psychological impact on investors has been evident. Cruise operators' stocks, such as Carnival, Norwegian Cruise Line, and Royal Caribbean, declined by up to 1% overnight after a 2% to 3% decline in the regular session. For many investors, the situation parallels the COVID-19 pandemic, which upended the entire travel industry. Though the U.S. cruise sector has largely recovered from the operational collapse caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, the industry’s largest operators continue to grapple with the long-term consequences of massive borrowing accumulated during the shutdown years. While Royal Caribbean has emerged as the standout performer with returns exceeding 233% over the past five years, rivals CCL and NCLH continue to battle elevated debt burdens and margin pressure. NCLH, in particular, has plunged nearly 40% over the last five years. To make matters worse, last week the company warned that softer travel demand and geopolitical uncertainty are weighing on bookings in key markets and unveiled additional cost-cutting measures to stabilize profits. However, according to a Reuters report, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has categorized the hantavirus outbreak as a Level 3 emergency response, its lowest emergency alert level. So far this year, NCLH and CCL stocks have plunged nearly 23% and 12%, respectively, while RCL stock has gained 0.7%. For updates and corrections, email newsroom[at]stocktwits[dot]com.
